scope.purpose: Let the user pick one number in a bounded range by moving a thumb along a track.
useCases: A price ceiling in a filter, with the value shown.
A setting from 0 to 100 in steps of 5.
exclusions: Two thumbs (RangeSlider, later), vertical orientation, tick marks and labels, a tooltip over the thumb.
Readonly and invalid: a slider always holds a value within its range; show a read-only value with DataField or Progress.
A size option: one track, density through the Density modes.
alternatives: Progress to show a measure without input.

decisionsTaken: Locale is a prop (BCP 47, default "en") for the value text (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T2).
One thumb, horizontal, showValue at the inline end of the track (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping: "Slider : Ok").
Built on Bits UI Slider (type single); Page Up/Page Down, aria-valuetext and the hidden form input are added by the component (absent from bits-ui 2.19.3 slider.svelte.js), with tests.

Track in color.choice.off.*.border, range and thumb border in color.choice.on.*.surface (a selection control, like Checkbox and Switch); thumb size and track thickness are component tokens (component.slider.thumb-size 20 px, track-thickness 4 px), not affected by density.
The thumb is positioned in CSS from the value (track inset by half a thumb), never with thumbPositioning contain, which measures on the client and would be wrong before hydration.

implementationNotes: Built on bits-ui 2.19.3 Slider (type single), pinned; the component completes it where it disagrees with the contract (decision Contract versus Bits UI), each covered by a browser or SSR test:
- Steps are passed as an array counted from min that always ends with max: Bits UI's own steps (normalizeSteps, helpers.js:161) leave max out when the range is not a multiple of step.

- The value passed to Bits UI is already within min and max and on a step: Bits UI rewrites a value that is not on a step (watch in slider.svelte.js), which would change the application's value and emit valueChange without a user action.
- Page Up and Page Down (ten steps), aria-valuetext (the value formatted for the locale) and the hidden form input are added: Bits UI has none of them.
- valueCommit is emitted only after a change: Bits UI commits on every key, also when the value did not change (End at max).

- The thumb and the range are positioned in CSS from a --_fraction custom property with logical properties (correct before hydration and in right-to-left); Bits UI's inline left/translate styles are dropped. The Bits UI root is the track inset by half a thumb, so that its box maps the pointer to the value; its hit area extends over the inset. The reading direction is measured once mounted and passed to Bits UI for the pointer.
valueChange during the drag and valueCommit on release map to Bits UI onValueChange and onValueCommit.
Other attributes go to the thumb (the focused element); the consumer's onkeydown runs before the component's (mergeProps composeHandlers stops when the event is handled).
